tei:div.tei:p: 333)༄༅/ ka ye gson dang gyang khang gi sprul sku/ kha bton thos bsam sgom gsum re mdzod dang*// ga ler sangs rgyas bstan pa yi rgyal mtshan// nga cag 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas su gyur 'ong*// ca co ngag 'khyal rnam g.yeng gi dus 'da'// cha lugs 'phyor chas mdzes chos re byas kyang*// ja dang tsam pa 'phrog brlag la btang nas// nya ma zhon pa'i ban rgod re 'byung ran// ta tha ga ta'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa// tha mal skye bos 'dzin skyong ni mi nus// da nas nyin mtshan mgo sbrel gyi brtson 'grus// nar mar bri gang med pa re mdzod dang*// pa sangs ltar dkar gzhan phan gyi byang sems// pha ma sems can bde ba dang ldan 'dod// ba mor nyi bzhin sdug bsngal ni bral 'dod// ma gyur 'gro la khyad med du sbyongs dang*// tsa ma ra bzhin rang 'dod kyi 'gong po// tsha grang dmyal bar sna 'dren gyi zhags pa// dza lang spyod 'di yul phud dang rjes 'don// wa skyes ded bzhin shul med la thongs dang*// zhwa ltar bla ma spyi gtsug tu sgom nas// za ma tsam yang gsol 'debs ni ma brjed// 'a 'ol blo sna dam chos la 'gyur nas// ya mtshan yon tan rang rgyud la skye 'ong*// rwa ltar rengs pa'i nga rgyal dang phrag dog /la la tsam 334)yang sems rgyud la med pa'i// sha tsha gros 'debs rang gis ni rang la// sa cha gang la gnas na yang ma brjed// ha ha bde nas bde ba ru 'gro ba'i// a a theg pa rim pa bzhin bgrod dang*// ha ha byar med blo bde ru chog pa'i// a ti rdzogs chen rim gyis ni rtogs 'ong*/ dge'o//
